_comment: Acceptance test: a drawn pitch line must be rendered at the pitch it was
drawn at. A4 = MIDI 69 = 440 Hz is held for 8 s. The first 3 s sit at the
notated pitch, the line then rises to +100 cents over 2 s and holds there
Measured on the last 2 s, the sounding f0 must be 466.16 Hz (440 x 2^(1/12))
within a few cents. This is the test that a pitch glide which smooths the
read rate has not also made it fall short of its target.
